author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing had a pill crossed by a short bar with a detached arc, and it read as a letter or a pill with a stick. It had no plane structure. Redrawn as the reference's glider seen from above, flying up to the right: a slim outlined fuselage with round nose and tail caps, long straight wings crossing it, a tailplane at the tail, and a curved air trail sweeping behind at the lower left.
omissions: Only one air trail fits (the reference has two). A second arc can't keep 8 units from the tail inside the square.
